title: The same request during a Wi-Fi outage

events.message: I enabled Wi-Fi and forgot the saved network, but Campus-Demo still will not connect. Check whether Wi-Fi is down. If it is operating, prepare a ticket about this problem.

result.message: The demo Wi-Fi service is unavailable across campus. The fixture gives no repair time.

steps.content: The Wi-Fi service is currently experiencing an outage across campus, so I cannot prepare a ticket for your issue at this time. If you need assistance with anything else or would like to discuss this further, please let me know!
